column1: # TERMBASE v1.0 — controlled vocabulary and romanisation authority for a public archive of religious shrines in Pakistan.

# ROMANISATION CONVENTION (LIGHT): long vowels marked with macrons only (a i u -> ā ī ū). ʿayn = ʿ (U+02BF). hamza = ʾ (U+02BE). NO under-dots and NO over-dots: write h s t d z n r s (not ḥ ṣ ṭ ḍ ẓ ṇ ṛ ś). Digraphs kh gh ch sh zh th dh ph. Sanskrit/Prakrit c -> ch (āchārya, chhatri), ś/ṣ -> sh, ṛ -> ri (garbhagriha), ṅ/ṃ -> n/m. Arabic definite article always "al-" and hyphenated (Rabīʿ al-Awwal), never "ul-" or "us-". Izāfat rendered "-e-" (Ahl-e-Sunnat, Shab-e-Barāt). Final silent -h dropped (fātiha not fātihah; khānqāh keeps -h because it is pronounced). Proper nouns capitalised and NOT italicised.
# COLUMNS: canonical <TAB> script <TAB> variants (semicolon-delimited, normalise TO canonical) <TAB> category <TAB> gloss <TAB> translate

# TRANSLATE VALUES: NO = keep the romanised term, italicised, with the gloss on first use in an entry. YES = do not use the foreign term in running prose, use the English gloss instead. NAME = proper noun, use as written, capitalised, roman (not italic), never translated.
# EMPTY script CELL = the compiler was not confident of the script rendering. Do not fill it by guessing.
